claim: A bounded hosted Linux debug app journey passed the analyzer, focused semantic/component tests, and the real create, invalid-import, retry/import, timeline insertion, keyboard duplicate, undo, seek and save/reopen journey under Xvfb.

verification.detail: The editor job used the canonical Flutter 3.47.5 pin, ran the analyzer and six focused component/semantics tests, then the real Linux journey under a bounded Xvfb display. Its seven-day artifact retains selected states, a clip semantics dump and resource metadata.

limitations: This is a Linux debug app with a substituted file picker; it is not an installed package or an OS-picker check.
The audio-only preflight can show 'Viewer texture unavailable', so it does not accept preview video rendering or audio playback.
The 1280x720 debug window can crowd inspector/media text; it is not a visual-polish or performance benchmark.
macOS, Windows and Android are not exercised by this workflow.
source: docs/PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md, 2026-10-15 quality pass; docs/TESTING.md, Evidence selection and bounded Linux preflight
